nonidentifiability: Effective finite-window quadrature only. Neither individual time constants nor capacities constitute measured microscopic traps. Equal history for all later controls; source-only 12694 fits not yet performed.
rate_support: 48 fixed log-midpoint exponential rates from inverse 7 days to inverse 8 s. One slow mode at inverse 14 days carries the analytic zero-to-inverse-7-days integral of the release-rate density. Its finite time constant gives finite integral; no extrapolated infinite power-law charge.
scope: Numerical and charge qualification of only the four positive scheduled exposure durations, no detector responses and no capacity calibration outcomes. Signed short-duration calibration rows and the original whole-history model are preserved separately.
test: 129 log ages, all table fluence knots and geometric midpoints, all four actual historical/scheduled durations. Single exposure maximum relative error <=0.005 versus native A-gamma algebra and total stored charge no greater than estimated delivered fluence. Charge conservation within 1e-12; zero/new-pulse and nonnegative finite-capacity gates. User source PerCal is authoritative. No dark data.
units: State release rate e-/s, rate constants s^-1, mode charge=state/rate in e-. Cap is e-/s per mode; convert to charge by dividing by the mode rate. Apply duration and fluence interpolation to full rate vector after constructing source-table kernels.
